text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hii, Trainer! I have a wonderful 
invitation today! Follow me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, Pearl-san. And to you as well, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I actually came to a Mejiro family tea 
party...! Jumping straight into such a 
majestic atmosphere is definitely making 
me nervous...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hii, Dober! Thanks for inviting me today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes! Please enjoy your time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, to think Dober would actually invite 
Pearl-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. You ran with me the other day... so 
think of this as a thank-you.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Dober told me you host tea parties often, 
so I asked if I could join in!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I see! Dober brews amazing black 
tea, so you really should have a cup!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~ Delicious! Your black tea is 
exquisite! This rich, deep flavor... 
Assam, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad it was to your liking... Just 
as you said, I tried brewing an Assam milk 
tea today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Dober picked out all the tea leaves and 
pastries for us this time, didn't she?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Those truffles over there were quite 
delicious, with a rich, milky flavor.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, truly, it's excellent! This financier 
has a rich buttery flavor that pairs 
wonderfully with the deep body of the 
Assam tea!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: What did you do last weekend, Palmer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I went to the driving range. I've been 
wanting to increase my driving distance, 
but it's pretty tough~

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, then hit it even harder and more 
powerfully! Why not give it a real solid 
smack!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Pearl, you know golf?! I wanna get 
more distance on my driver, mind if I ask 
for some advice?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I went out into the garden to practice 
golf swings with Mejiro Palmer. I've never 
heard of Seeking the Pearl playing golf 
before, though...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The club face orientation has stabilized, 
but I just can't seem to get my head speed 
up...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"If you wanna speed up, winding up at full 
power is the best way!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: With guts and explosive power—home run!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I see... So explosive power during the 
downswing is the key...! Power... which 
means I need arm muscle too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"You wanna build muscle that packs 
explosive power? Then I recommend working 
on your antagonist muscles!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
For example, with arms, you train the 
agonist bicep together with the antagonist 
tricep as a pair!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
In other words, it's a better deal as a 
combo! Fast food is always a better value 
in a set than individually, that's just 
how the world works!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, exactly! This is a remarkably 
effective way to train!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Training your antagonist muscles 
stabilizes the muscle group and improves 
the flexibility of your agonist muscles, 
too. That's why it gives your explosive 
power such a huge boost!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, great! Muscles truly hold immense 
potential!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, exactly! To think that even Pearl-san 
could understand the appeal of muscles~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It feels like the conversation has been 
slightly out of sync the entire time... 
but strangely enough, everyone seems to be 
having a great time chatting.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what do you think?! About the 
limitless potential of biceps!
choice_data_list:
Maybe I could even beat a gorilla someday— 
just kidding!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Of course, exactly! The possibilities are 
always infinite!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You're right! All right, I'm gonna push my 
biceps to their absolute limit!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"No, Ryan! There are no limits. Let us 
soar as high as we can!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
! Yes, let's go all out! First up, 
dumbbells!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on! With full power! Pumping with 
energy!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the tea party somehow morphed into 
a workout session, but they thoroughly 
enjoyed spending time together 
nonetheless.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I was about to follow up with 
"Just kidding"—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
What an eccentric idea! Just as expected 
of my Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'll train and get strong enough to beat a 
gorilla. And then... a wrestling match 
against a gorilla!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, how challenging and fun! Let's 
negotiate with the zoo right away—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"P-Please wait, Pearl-san! That's really 
going too far...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That challenge was far too dangerous, so I 
teamed up with Mejiro Dober to desperately 
calm Seeking the Pearl down.
